blind.description: A stylized fantasy/cartoon mechanical pump consisting of a small vertical wooden barrel banded with iron hoops, mounted onto a low rectangular wooden beam skid with bolted metal brackets. The lower portion of the barrel has a green mossy tint. On top sits an iron piston mechanism connected to a side-mounted metal flywheel with a hand crank. A curved reddish-brown hose or pipe bends downward along one side from the top mechanism, secured with metal brackets.
blind.from_above: A circular barrel top with a central bolted metal mechanical cap, a curved maroon pipe extending along the left side, a metallic flywheel disc with an extended wooden handle on the right, and the wooden skid frame ends projecting at the bottom and top corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% the height of the figure (around 2.3 to 2.5 ft tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 ft wide across the base and crank.
